ranking_root_cause: selectDiversePortfolio deliberately applied diversity/near-duplicate/same-country penalties, so a lower-scoring proposal could be shown before a higher-scoring Sauerland proposal.
ranking_change: Visible proposals are now ordered strictly by portfolioScore, then raw score, then preference coverage. Diversity no longer reorders higher scores behind lower scores.
route_root_cause: Leaflet route rendering was invoked while mapView was hidden. The app then relied on invalidateSize later. On mobile this can leave the map initialized without a reliably drawn route.
route_change: Route rendering is deferred while mapView is hidden. Opening Kaart now renders the current plan after the view becomes visible, then invalidates/fits the map.
